PART 2: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate words from the box. There are MORE words than you need. Do NOT change the forms.
Word Bank: projections, terminate, vague, cultivate, norm, abstract, bear, revolve, derived, expense, scope, rough, executive, foundation

items.questionText: 1. The word ‘politics’ is ____________ from a Greek word meaning ‘city’.
2. An employer is entitled to ____________ an employee’s contract when the employee has committed a serious breach of the agreement.
3. In order to ____________ a professional image for yourself, be a positive communicator. What you say and how you say it are important factors in image building. Remember to be a good listener.
4. The ____________ funded a dozen new career centers in high schools, where students could come for career guidance and counseling.
5. I am having the windows, doors and frames painted next month, so that is a/an ____________ that was unexpected.
6. Julia was ____________ about where she had been and what she had been doing. Obviously, she didn’t want anybody to know her whereabouts at the time of the incident.

7. Very few projects are ever completed in line with original plans. Due to unforeseen changes such as the goals, deadlines, tasks, etc., project managers may have to expand or narrow the ____________ of their projects.
8. He did not want to devote more time to his business at the ____________ of his family, so he closed it down. He wanted to spend more time with his wife and kids.
9. Please ____________ with me while I find my notes. It shouldn’t take long. In the meantime, if you want, you can go over the handouts I have just given.
10. The demographic ____________ outlined earlier indicate that a large proportion of future homeowners will consist of single middle-aged and older people.
11. Some of these theories are so ____________ that they don’t seem to relate to our everyday work. They don’t provide actual, practical solutions to everyday issues at all.
12. Based on the initial data, we can provide a ____________ estimate of the project's cost, but a more detailed analysis will be needed for accuracy.
13. Her studies ____________ around the question of whether genetically modified foods are safe.

instruction: PART 3: Fill in the gaps with the correct word. BE CAREFUL about verb forms (Ving, V1, etc.).

items.questionText: [persist / insist] 1. She is 85 now, but she ____________on doing all her own housework.
[persist / insist] 2. If the pain ____________, consult a doctor.
[persist / insist] 3. They ____________ that all swear words be deleted from the article.
[persist / insist] 4. If he ____________ in asking awkward questions, then send him to the boss.
[rate / ratio] 5. Over the last year, the ____________ of inflation has gone up to almost 7 percent.
[rate / ratio] 6. The school is trying to improve its pupil-teacher ____________ (= the number of teachers compared with the number of students).
[rate / ratio] 7. The ____________ of applications to available places currently stands at 100:1.
[rate / ratio] 8. The city's most shocking statistic is its high infant mortality ____________.
[differentiate / different / difference / differ] 9. His accent is ____________ now from before he went to Australia.
[differentiate / different / difference / differ] 10. There is a big ____________ between knowing that something is true and being able to prove it.

[differentiate / different / difference / differ] 11. If a mother’s decision to allow her kids to stay up past their bedtimes _______________ from her husband’s decision, this will send mixed messages to the kids.
[differentiate / different / difference / differ] 12. Customers may wonder what ____________ one type of beer from another.
[differentiate / different / difference / differ] 13. His views ____________ considerably from those of his parents.
[differentiate / different / difference / differ] 14. Emily is entirely ____________ from her sister.
[compose / consist / comprise / constitute] 15. The course is ____________ of a class book, a practice book, and a CD.
[compose / consist / comprise / constitute] 16. Her responsibilities ____________ of answering the phone and greeting visitors.
[compose / consist / comprise / constitute] 17. Those under 18-years-old _____________ nearly 25 percent of the town's population.

items.questionText: 1. The school will have to be rebuilt. In the ____________, teachers are using temporary classrooms.

3. Trina closed her eyes and counted to twenty; ____________, the other children ran to hide.
4. We are a one-income family now. ____________, we will not be taking two vacation trips this year.
5. He was jailed for 30 months for possession of class A drugs, ____________ heroin and cocaine.
6. I am glad you told me about the show being cancelled. ____________, I would have travelled all the way to Glasgow for nothing.
